title: PowerToys gets dublicate installs after updating
author: DeFaLT-dj

status.label: needs current installer-state evidence
status.detail: Evidence establishes the old-version update loop, but not whether current failures are stale registration or simultaneous install scopes.

next_action.label: Request installed-app snapshot and /bugreport
next_action.reason: Capture an untouched current failure before cleanup.

judgment.rationale: The report and corroborating comment establish repeated 0.100-to-0.100.2 update loops, but installer behavior has changed and no fresh post-update snapshot distinguishes stale registration from simultaneous install scopes.
evidence: The original reporter supplied a screenshot and diagnostic archive from 0.100.0 installed through Microsoft Store.
They report old and new entries, with launches still opening the old version.
A second user reports automatic startup at 0.100 while 0.100.2 is repeatedly offered.
Current installer source has distinct per-user/per-machine upgrade codes and detection paths.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current reproduction snapshot and fresh diagnostic ZIP before any manual cleanup.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys updates can leave the system launching the older version while a newer version appears installed or repeatedly offered.
known_information: The failure occurred multiple times for the original reporter.
A second user independently reports the same old-version startup/update loop.
The evidence is from the 0.100/0.100.2 period.
inferences: The symptom could reflect stale installer registration, mixed install scopes, or updater launch-path behavior.
issue_context.analysis: Because setup code and release versioning have changed, a fresh untouched state is necessary before selecting an installer component.
initial_investigation: Reviewed PowerToysSetupVNext upgrade detection: per-user and per-machine packages use different UpgradeCode values and are both searched.
Reviewed recent installer history, including later setup process-termination and preview-versioning changes.

actions.label: Request duplicate-install evidence

comment.body:
The screenshot, original 0.100 diagnostic, and second report of repeatedly returning to 0.100 establish the update loop. Since setup and versioning have changed, one current untouched failure is needed.

**Needed**
1. After a current stable update reports success but still launches the old version, please capture the PowerToys entries shown in Settings > Installed apps and state the exact update source and install scope.
2. Before deleting or repairing anything, please submit a comment containing `/bugreport` immediately so the generated ZIP captures the failed-update state.

This will distinguish duplicate install scopes from stale registration or updater launch-path state.

actions.note: Draft only; no upstream comment is posted without explicit approval.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys installer fix cannot be selected until current evidence distinguishes mixed install scopes from stale registration or launch-path state.
